shared: &external {policy: open}
adapters:
  wecom:
    token: old-bot-id

      secret: old-secret

        self: *groups

cases.after:
shared:
  policy: open
adapters:
  wecom:
    enabled: true
    token: old-bot-id
    extra:
      secret: old-secret
      websocket_url: wss://openws.work.weixin.qq.com
      dm_policy: open
      group_policy: disabled
      groups: &a2
        first: &a1
          allow:
            - one
            - two
        second: *a1
        self: *a2
        external:
          policy: open
